name: agent-orchestration
use_when: Coordinate bounded live agent dispatch, swarm integration, collaboration, delta briefs, and optional mux transport. Use when users invoke /delegate-codex, /swarm, collaboration-protocol, a delta brief, a Zellij swarm, or live agent dispatch.
do_not_use_when: a durable goal, phase gate, or GOAL_LEDGER.md is needed; goal-protocol owns that lifecycle
a one-shot PRD, issue slice, reviewed plan, or durable agent brief is wanted; planning-workflow owns that artifact
the request operates Herdr or Maestri private transport surfaces

name: caveman
use_when: Use a compact technical communication mode with a clear safety exception. Use only when the user explicitly says "caveman mode", "use caveman", or invokes /caveman.
do_not_use_when: the user did not explicitly invoke caveman mode
a safety warning, irreversible-action confirmation, or clarification would be less clear in compressed form

name: chrome-extension-builder
use_when: Build browser extensions with MV3-safe state, typed messages, isolated content UI, and narrow permissions. Use when a service worker, content script, extension storage, permission, or browser message changes.
do_not_use_when: the work has no browser-extension surface
a product-platform routing decision is needed before an extension implementation boundary

name: code-quality
use_when: Run evidence-based code-quality, non-Go diagnosis, and merge-readiness passes. Use when users request thermonuclear review, ruthless test strategy, TDD, zero tech debt, ShoeHorn migration, or a merge gate.
do_not_use_when: a Go performance regression or Go verification claim is the first concern; go-lang owns it
a Kubernetes or infrastructure-as-code desired/live failure is the concern; infra-bundles owns it

name: design-family
use_when: Shape production interfaces through build, review, and improve modes. Use when users request frontend design, UI audit, UI critique, UI improve, UI tune, or userinterface-wiki guidance.
do_not_use_when: an Expo, React Native, styling-adapter, native API, or platform implementation decision is needed; product-platform owns it
a throwaway state-model harness or competing UI variant is needed only to answer one question; prototype owns it

name: effect-framework
use_when: Apply Effect decision policy for services, lifecycles, typed failures, concurrent flows, test layers, and upgrades. Use when Context.Service/Layer, Scope/runtime, Exit/Cause, Fiber/Stream, @effect/vitest, or v3-to-v4 code needs a boundary decision.
do_not_use_when: generic TypeScript or source-code diagnosis is needed; code-quality owns it
desired-versus-live infrastructure failure diagnosis is needed; infra-bundles owns it

name: elixir-lang
use_when: Apply Elixir/OTP decision policy for process topology, supervision, pipelines, fault signals, tests, and runtime evidence. Use when a GenServer, Supervisor, Task/Broadway flow, :telemetry boundary, ExUnit process test, ETS/mailbox, or NIF/port decision needs a boundary.
do_not_use_when: generic source-code diagnosis is needed; code-quality owns it
desired-versus-live infrastructure failure diagnosis is needed; infra-bundles owns it

name: git-guardrails-claude-code
use_when: Install a Claude Code PreToolUse guard that blocks named destructive Git commands before execution. Use when the user requests Claude Git guardrails, blocked push, or protection from reset/clean.
do_not_use_when: general Git safety is wanted without a Claude Code PreToolUse hook
the target scope or settings/hook merge boundary is ambiguous

name: go-lang
use_when: Apply a compact Go decision policy for public contracts, goroutine lifetimes, and verification evidence. Use when an exported Go API, error boundary, goroutine, race, benchmark, or Go performance regression needs a decision; non-Go diagnosis belongs to code-quality.
do_not_use_when: non-Go source-code diagnosis is needed; code-quality owns it
Kubernetes or infrastructure-as-code desired/live failure diagnosis is needed; infra-bundles owns it

name: goal-protocol
use_when: Run a traceable durable-goal lifecycle through convergence, dossier, approvals, parent-traced packets, and ledger updates. Use when users invoke /goal, codex-goal, /goal-council, /code-council, /goal-orchestrator, or six-phase.
do_not_use_when: a one-shot PRD, issue slice, or reviewed implementation plan is wanted; planning-workflow owns it
approved packets need live delegation, monitoring, review, or integration; agent-orchestration owns that execution surface

name: grill-me
use_when: Interrogate a plan one question at a time until its decisions are explicit. Use when the user says "grill me"; "grill me with docs" selects the docs mode.
do_not_use_when: an ordinary planning, review, or implementation request does not explicitly invoke grill me
the user has not supplied a plan or design scope to interrogate

name: gtr
use_when: Operate Git Worktree Runner with configured worktree topology and destructive-operation guardrails. Use when the user names git gtr, a gtr worktree, or an isolated gtr workspace.
do_not_use_when: Git worktree work does not use the installed git gtr surface
a destructive worktree action lacks the user's confirmation

name: herdr
use_when: Operate local Herdr workspaces, panes, and agent transport safely from its CLI. Use when a task names Herdr or needs a Herdr pane read, literal agent send, pane command, or workspace operation.
do_not_use_when: generic agent dispatch does not operate a Herdr transport surface
the installed Herdr CLI or target state cannot be verified

name: infra-bundles
use_when: Route Kubernetes and IaC desired/live work through kubernetes-operations, kubernetes-platform, iac-operations, or iac-platform. Use when a task names a Kubernetes cluster, Terraform/OpenTofu state, a Terraform/OpenTofu plan, IaC drift, infrastructure recovery, or a Kubernetes rollout.
do_not_use_when: generic source-code diagnosis is needed; code-quality owns it
product planning or implementation design is needed; planning-workflow or product-platform owns it

name: local-dev
use_when: Operate local development topology through selected Portless, isolation, proxy, or project-context modes without storing credentials or machine facts. Use when configuring a local dev route, isolated workspace, dev proxy, or durable project context.
do_not_use_when: a credential value or secret lookup is needed
a production deployment, cloud, or generic code-quality decision is needed instead of local development topology

name: local-http-browser-use
use_when: Operate a user-authorized visible browser through its local HTTP bridge with observe-act-verify and sensitive-action consent. Use when BROWSER_BRIDGE_URL is available for Chrome or Brave web-app interaction.
do_not_use_when: BROWSER_BRIDGE_URL is unavailable
the browser session is not user-authorized or a sensitive action lacks consent

name: maestri
use_when: Operate Maestri canvas participants, connected notes, and portal browser nodes with exact transport and fresh accessibility refs. Use when the user names Maestri, a canvas participant, connected note, or Maestri portal.
do_not_use_when: generic collaboration or terminal transport does not operate a Maestri surface
the required Maestri target or fresh portal accessibility state cannot be verified

name: peon-ping
use_when: Control the installed Claude Code peon-ping notification hook without exposing its full configuration. Use when the user names peon-ping, sound mute/resume, volume, sound pack, rotation, or notification category.
do_not_use_when: the installed peon-ping hook or requested live configuration field is absent
generic operating-system notification settings or a full configuration dump is wanted

name: planning-workflow
use_when: Produce governed one-shot PRDs, reviewed plans, issue work, triage, AFK briefs, setup, and out-of-scope records. Use when users request a PRD, reviewed implementation plan, issue triage, issue slicing, agent brief, or /setup-matt-pocock-skills.
do_not_use_when: durable multi-session goals, phase gates, or a GOAL_LEDGER.md are needed; goal-protocol owns them
the work is live agent dispatch or wave execution without a one-shot artifact; agent-orchestration owns it

name: product-platform
use_when: Route product platform work to mobile, expo-platform, uniwind-migration, terminal-ui, or chrome-extension-builder. Use when an Expo/RN platform, Expo SDK, NativeWind migration, OpenTUI interface, or browser extension needs an owner.
do_not_use_when: interface-design intent is needed; design-family owns it
installed Uniwind styling decisions are needed; uniwind owns them
generic source-code diagnosis or local runtime setup is needed; code-quality or local-dev owns it

name: prototype
use_when: Build a throwaway executable prototype that answers one design question through a state-model harness or competing UI variants. Use when the user explicitly asks to prototype a state machine, data model, interaction, or alternative UI.
do_not_use_when: the requested work is intended as production implementation
a production-interface decision or generic code change is wanted without a disposable experiment

name: release-bundles
use_when: Assess mobile-store release readiness with evidence gates for builds, quality, metadata, safety, commerce, access, and submission. Use when an App Store or Google Play release, TestFlight/Play track, release metadata, privacy/rating declaration, subscription, or submission automation needs a verdict.
do_not_use_when: app implementation or build-workflow design is needed; product-platform owns it
generic source-code diagnosis is needed; code-quality owns it
the request would mutate release state without explicit user confirmation

name: repoprompt-pro-review
use_when: Prepare a bounded RepoPrompt context export for an external reviewer without Context Builder or Oracle/send. Use when the user names RepoPrompt, ChatGPT Pro review, selected files, or a review export.
do_not_use_when: Context Builder, Oracle, or send operations are requested
a general code review is wanted without a bounded RepoPrompt context export

name: riff-partner
use_when: Run an explicit idea-stage thought-partner riff that commits to a grounded verdict and pressure-tests it. Use only when the user explicitly asks to riff, asks for a thought partner, or invokes riff-partner.
do_not_use_when: ordinary implementation, debugging, review, or a generic request for an opinion is made
the user did not explicitly ask to riff or for a thought partner

name: skill-authoring
use_when: Apply this pack's normative skill-design contract to create, consolidate, or review canonical skills. Use when authoring a SKILL.md, choosing an archetype, or running the pack acceptance gate.
do_not_use_when: a generic application-code task does not change a canonical skill
a standing skill is only a compatibility alias, generic knowledge, or a one-off setup note

name: uniwind
use_when: Apply Uniwind conventions for RN styling, setup, static class names, themes, and bindings. Use when Uniwind Metro/CSS, className, a theme token, a color prop, or a style failure needs a decision.
do_not_use_when: the work is a NativeWind-to-Uniwind migration; product-platform owns it
the issue is generic rendering or source diagnosis rather than Uniwind configuration, class, token, binding, or style resolution

name: crew
use_when: Run a sustained multi-agent campaign with a cross-family crew, durable verdict files, re-gate loops, and trigger chains. Use when the user says crew, full crew, or adversarial convergence.
do_not_use_when: one bounded task needs one agent; agent-orchestration owns delegate/swarm
the request is Herdr transport syntax
short interactive work below roughly an hour or three workstreams
